1. Exams 
Every student is entitled to two examination opportunities, per course, per academic year. Students are 
automatically registered for exams and rest exams (no extra subscription or payment is necessary). 
EXAMS PERIOD: 
Autumn term: Jan 12 to Feb, 13 2026 
Spring term: Jun, 8 to Jul, 11 2026 
2. Grading systems of the institutions 
University of Cordoba: Student performance is graded individually and not on a statistical basis.  
The grading scale ranges from 0 to 10 (5 or highest is a passing grade) 
More information at: 
https://www.uco.es/internacional/extranjeros/images/documentos/EquivalenceMarksECTS.pdf  
 
D.  Language requirements 
Most modules and exams are carried out in Spanish language. Course courses in English are detailed here: 
http://www.uco.es/internacional/extranjeros/en/courses#courses 
Erasmus+ students are not required to present a specific language certificate and do not need to pass a 
specific language level test. 
Language courses:  
Incoming students can attend Spanish Academic courses  in our Language Institute (Ucoidiomas) in three 
levels: A1, B1 and B2. Everyone has its own characteristics of access (B1 and B2 with previous online test). 
These courses, are considered as subject a nd they has all features of any other University subjects, such as 
attending in classroom, works, study, examinations, etc. 
More information on: https://www.uco.es/idiomas/spanish-for-foreigners/

F. Cost of living 
The overall cost of living for a reg ular student in Co rdoba is approximately  EUR 500 -600 per month, 
including housing, food, books, study materials, transports, etc.  
More information at: http://www.uco.es/internacional/extranjeros/en/about-uco/10-withoutcategory/48-
practical-information 
G.  Visa 
The sending and receiving institutions will provide assistance, when required, in securing visas for incoming 
and outbound students participating in mobility programs. 
Information and assistance: 
Contact details Website for information 
visa.support@uco.es http://www.uco.es/internacional/extranjeros/en/visas 
H.  Insurance 
Erasmus+ students must present adequate medical coverage for their stay in  Spain, in accordance with 
current regulations of their place of residence and / or the Spanish Consulate or Embassy where they apply 
for their visa. 
In addition, it is compulsory to have travel and accident insurance before arrival at the University of 
Cordoba. Incoming students can obtain the same insurance coverage that the University of Cordoba offers its 
own students, which is private but has a special price (approximately EUR 19). More information at:  
https://aties.acetravelinsurance.com/CumLaude/PA/Quote (‘Programa de Intercambio’ Option) 
Other travel and accident insurance with equivalent coverage  may also be accepted and must equally  be 
presented. 
It is also highly recommended for all EU citizens to obtain the European Health Insurance Card (EHIC blue 
card) before their arrival.

I. Admission process 
1. - Institution must send a nomination/presentation letter* with student data;full name, passport, studies and 
period of time of exchange, duly signed and sealed by the responsible person of his/her School. 
 
(*these steps (1 and 2) must be in parallel, one before another, it's not important which one is the first, but before 
send his/her admission letter we need to have both documents in our office) 
 
2.- The student must upload his/her data on the online Application Form and send a copy of the report with 
his/her proposal of Learning Agreement, both documents can be found on this link: 
 
(Please, review the information shown in this website because there are another important documents that must 
be brought with him/her) 
 
http://www.uco.es/internacional/extranjeros/en/how-to-register#non-erasmus-exchange-students 
 
These documents must be sent by the student to: incoming.student@uco.es 
 
3. - The proposal of subjects that the student includes on his/her Learning Agreement must be checked and 
accepted by the Coordinator of the School where the student is going to attend lessons in UCO. 
 
The student can find information about Schools on this link: 
 
http://www.uco.es/internacional/extranjeros/en/how-to-register#non-erasmus-exchange-students 
 
The student can find the academic study plan of every Degree with information about contents, credits, teachers 
and so on. This information can be found on the subsection "Planificación de la enseñanza" 
 
It's very important to choose subjects from the "2º cuatrimestre (2nd term: from February to July) or 1º 
cuatrimestre (1st quarter: from September to February) " which are those subjects that are going to be given every 
quarter in UCO. 
 
4. -  Those students who intend to do internships in the area of Medicine / Nursing / Physiotherapy / Education, 
must provide, additionally, Certificate of Criminal / Sexual Offenses in their Country. 
 
Once in our country, they will be guided for the delivery of a certificate of confidentiality in the Office of 
International Relations and assistance to our Government Subdelegation to be issued to those who have no 
history of such crimes in our country. 
 
5. - Copy of insurance of health and accidents (with covering for full stay in our University) 
 
We offer an option that could be interesting for the student  about 250 € for full stay) and full covering)  
 
https://www.oncampus.es/es/seguros/oncampus-healthcare 
 
6.- If the academic proposal is alright we will make his/her admission letter and will send it electronically signed 
to the student. 
 
The student must keep every document needed on the process in order to let him/her show it in our office if 
needed. 
 
We usually reply and finish our part of the process (mainly checking of academic proposals) in one or two days, 
so when the time of nomination starts, I recommend the student initiate his/her process in order to guarantee the 
best options taken into account that could have any inconvenience.

Our times to receive nominations/Application from Universities/students are:  
 
Fall semester and full academic year:  
.- Nomination (University) from 15th March to 15th April)  
.- Application (students) from 15th April (or after Nomination) till May 15th 
Spring Semester 
.- Nomination (University) from 15th September to 15th October)  
.- Application (students) from 15th October (or after Nomination) till November 15th
